invariants.rationale: The final result is collected via Collectors.toList(), which produces a non-null list.
Each input element may at most contribute one output value; groupBy may reduce multiple elements with the same key.
Parallelism for a parallel stream must be positive to have a meaningful value.
The method streams data, so data must not be null.
mapToPairFunc is wrapped and used as the mapping function, so it must be non-null.
